Damage = average per hit with your skill.en: Damage = average per hit with your skills (primary attack). Combo finisher ×2, secondary attacks, Dvergr buff and DoT ticking are not included.

Damage = average per hit with your skill.de: Schaden = Durchschnitt pro Treffer mit deinen Fertigkeiten (Primärangriff). Komboabschluss ×2, Sekundärangriffe, Dvergr-Bonus und Schaden über Zeit sind nicht enthalten.
Damage = average per hit with your skill.es: Daño = promedio por golpe con tus habilidades (ataque principal). No incluye remate de combo ×2, ataques secundarios, mejora dvergr ni daño periódico.
